messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need a concise, unified set of signals for the release dashboards (A/B and rollout pages). Product wants cost-per-route visible alongside perf deltas. Can infra/runtime weigh in on what we can reliably emit from the agents?

omar: +1. From runtime side: we can emit latency histograms, batch_size histograms, kv_cache.hit_ratio, and a routing label. We should standardize labels: `route`, `model`, `deployment`, `experiment_id`, `variant`, `region`. Keep cardinality low.

ryan: Also push `queued_requests` and `active_workers` from the scheduler. For batching effects we need `batch_size_hist` (buckets) and `seq_len_hist`. Histograms make delta comparisons easier than raw percentiles.

ellen: UX ask: consoles should show baseline vs variant columns, percent delta, and an inline sparkline. Top-left: traffic + cost. Top-right: p50/p95. Second row: error rate + cache hit. Third: regression detector and any active alerts.

jess: Note on quotas/routing: quota-weighted routing will change effective traffic mix. We need an emitted label `routed_fraction` or `quota_bucket` so dashboard math can normalize. Also need an approximated per-request cost metric from the runtime: tokens_in, tokens_out. We can compute cost = tokens_total * model_unit_cost + infra_unit_cost.

maria: Agree. Proposal for minimal signal set to ship:
- traffic.count (labelled by route, variant, experiment_id)
- tokens.in/out (per-request aggregated, emit as counters)
- latency.hist (buckets) and latency.p50/p95 (derived)
- errors.count and errors.type
- kv_cache.hit_ratio
- batch_size.hist
- routed_fraction / quota_bucket
- model_fallback_rate

omar: Implementation note: telemetry agent will emit Prom-style metrics plus an event for sample-level details when we need to diagnose. For the metrics contract, prefer metric names with dot convention: `inference.latency`, `inference.cache.hit_ratio`, `inference.cost.tokens`.

maria: Example event/metric proto (sketch):

```json
{
  "metric": "inference.latency.p95",
  "value": 123.4,
  "labels": {
    "route": "text_generate",
    "model": "rw-v2-8b-quant",
    "variant": "treatment",
    "experiment_id": "exp_2026_03",
    "region": "us-west-2"
  },
  "window": "60s"
}
```

omar: Looks good. For histograms we emit `latency_bucket` with `le` label and then derive p50/p95 in the metrics pipeline. Also add `sample_rate` when emitting aggregated events so downstream calcs understand sampling.

ryan: On regression detection: don't rely solely on raw delta. Use bootstrap CIs or two-sample t-test with min N threshold. Practical rule: require >= 2k requests per side and use >=5% relative delta + p < 0.01 to flag. We should also surface effect size (Cohen's d) and absolute delta.

elllen: Minor UI detail: allow toggling normalization modes — per-req, per-1k tokens, and per-1k requests. Some customers care about tokens.

jess: For cost panels, we'll need `tokens_total` aggregated by route+variant and `model_cost_per_token` static mapping (config) to compute est_cost. Also include `gpu_seconds` metric so we can reconcile infra cost.

metrics-bot: new metric registered: `inference.rollout.delta_signal.v1` (emiters: runtime-agent, telemetry-pipeline) :eyes:

devbot: deploy: telemetry-agent v0.9.3 -> will add `routed_fraction` label and tokens counters in canary tomorrow.

omar: One API debate: do we send `routed_fraction` as percent (0-100) or fraction (0-1)? I vote fraction (consistent with other gauges).

ryan: Fraction is fine. Also add `quota_bucket` with low-cardinality values like `free`, `standard`, `reserved`.

maria: Quick consensus: fraction + quota_bucket. I'll open a telemetry contract PR with the proto sketch and a dashboard wireframe (png). @omar @ryan @ellen please review the labels + min-cardinality checks.

ellen: I can mock the dashboard layout this afternoon and add exportable JSON for the console.

jess: FYI: sales asked for SLA-aware views (SLOs per customer tier). We should include a `customer_tier` label where available, else `unknown`. Keep it optional to avoid cardinality explosion.

omar: Implementation checklist for runtime: emit histograms, tokens counters, kv cache metric, `routed_fraction`, and `model_fallback_rate`. Sampler will add `sample_rate`.

maria: Thanks — I'll file the follow-ups: 1) telemetry contract PR, 2) dashboard mock, 3) regression-detector config (thresholds + bootstrap). Target: ship to canary in 2 weeks. :thumbsup:

metrics-bot: note: historical data backfill not possible for tokens counters — dashboards will show data from emit start only. :thinking_face:
